notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.8
notes.content: [p]Hey folks! [/p][p][/p][p]We've just released a hotfix (Build 1.0.8) for an issue where Steam Achievements were not registering, caused by a bug introduced with the 1.0.7 update on June 26th (last Thursday), meaning any Steam Achievements earned during this period were not activating. [/p][p][/p][p]As the bulk of the achievements in Axyz are tied to collecting the tapes, beating the high scores and completing the levels for each World, you should be able to unlock any missing achievements simply by beating a level in any previous World you have completed. [/p][p][/p][p]For example, if you collected all tapes and high scores for each level in World 1 (and thus completed World 1), you should be able to unlock the 3 achievements tied to these objectives simply by beating any level in World 1 (just grab the key and head to the exit!). [/p][p][/p][p]If you collected all the tapes but not all the high scores, you will only earn the achievements for the tapes and beating World 1. [/p][p][/p][p]If you continue to run into any issues, please let us know! [/p][p]You can also jump into our [url="https://discord.gg/SbjFtqPgBz"]Discord[/url] to provide a report. [/p]

notes.title: Patch v1.0.5
notes.content:
Hey folks! A new patch is here!

We've noticed that players often move directly from core levels to the bonus levels of a specific world, which can lead to a significant increase in difficulty. We've tweaked the flow so that the game encourages you to play through all the core levels first and then head back to the bonus levels.

We've also locked off the bonus levels till you have completed all 10 core levels for that respective world.

Selecting Streamer Mode was causing a couple of issues with certain songs. This has now been fixed, and all tracks safe for streaming mode will play correctly!

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where, sometimes, certain streaming-safe tracks would always be skipped during streamer mode.
[*] Bonus levels are now only playable after completing all core levels in their respective world.
[*] Improved loading times when scrolling through locked levels during level selection.
[*] Updated credits to include the contributor for Japanese localization.
[/list]

Thank you, as always, for your reports and feedback!

xoxo

notes.title: Steam Deck Update
notes.content:
Hey folks! Just want to give a quick note about Axyz on Steam Deck. 

We made an original post about this [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2850490/view/543349604658184884?l=english]here [/url]a few weeks ago but there's been some updates since then. 

We've managed to fix the outlying issues we had, which means the following: 
- The game recognises you're playing on Steam Deck and will lock the resolution to 1280x720
- Menu navigation is fully working with Dpad

The only thing that you might notice is the game will use XBox controller glyphs instead of the Steam Deck glyphs. We'll likely figure that out at some point but it should not make any difference to your experience with the game. 

We've also yet to configure Steam Cloud saving but we're hoping to get that added in soon. 

We'd love to get the game Steam Deck verified but we currently can't do much till Valve takes notice of us *waves hands furiously in the air*

notes.title: Demo Update 0.0.7v
notes.content:
Another day, another patch!

We've added a Vsync toggle and the ability to lock the frame rate at 60.

We've also made a couple of small visual adjustments to improve the clarity of barriers and when you collect tapes.

[list]
[*] Added frame rate limit and Vsync options to the settings menu.
[*] Adjusted music volume for a more consistent audio experience across tracks.
[*] Uncollected tapes now appear more transparent to better distinguish them from collected ones.
[*] Brightened barrier material for improved visibility.
[/list]


We're also excited to announce that speedrun data for auto-splitter support has been implemented and that Nikoheart, a member of the speedrunning community, will be uploading a Livesplitter for the Axyz demo soon!

We've greatly improved the smoothness of camera movement. You should notice this when jumping or gravity switching. 

We've also fixed a few minor visual issues for good measure.  

[list]
[*] Updated UI in preparation for additional languages
[*] Updated fonts in preparation for additional languages
[*] Added French and German language support
[*] Added a word missing in the movement tutorial
[*] Added automatic scrolling to dropdown elements in the settings menu
[*] Improved smoothness when jumping/falling below your current horizontal position
[*] Coins and gems no longer respawn in a level after being collected when transitioning to the victory screen
[*] Fixed an issue that caused certain song names to not scroll correctly in the HUD
[/list]

You can send additional reports through Steam or on our Discord! 

(also please ignore we skipped 0.0.5v)

notes.title: Final update for the year!
notes.content:
Hey folks! As we begin to wrap up for the year I just want to take a moment to reflect on what a crazy past 12 months it has been. 

Since January 1st we've showcased in 4 countries at 11 events, had hundreds, probably thousands of players spend time playing Axyz, talk to us, give us feedback, and some of you were even kind enough to wishlist the game. 

Outside of making the game, this has easily been my most favourite part of the whole experience and I just want to say thank you for making this the most fun year I've had on a professional level. 

We're now entering the busiest part of the development window as we try to get this thing out the door, and we've been fortunate enough to bring on some incredibly talented people to help us get across the finishing line. They've already made some noticible differences and I cannot wait to see how the game evolves between now and release day. 

We're edging closer towards a personal goal of reaching 1K wishlists, so if you know anyone who would be interested in puzzlegames, vaporwave or PSX era vibes - be sure to send them on a link to the steam page! 

For now, have a very merry christmas and happy new year. We'll see you in 2025. 

ciao.
Mark
xxx

notes.title: The Game Awards For Games Who Can't Afford the Game Awards 2024
notes.content:
Hey folks! It's time for your weekly update. 

[h1]The Game Awards For Games Who Can't Afford the Game Awards 2024[/h1]

In case you missed it, some wonderful folks decided to put together an [url=https://tgagwcaga.com]event for games[/url] not involved in the upcoming Game Awards. 

While Axyz was not selected for the main showcase, the game is still up as part of the honorable mentions category and we are honoured to be involved against a stacked list of games. We'd like to thank the event organisers for including us. 

[h1]Axyz hits 700 wishlists![/h1]

We set a target when developeted started of hitting 1k wishlists before launch, and we're on target as we hit 700 wishlists yesterday. A massive thank you to everyone who has wishlisted the game! If you know anyone who likes puzzle games, vaporwave or Kula World - be sure to let them know and get a wishlist going! Every last one helps us massively. 

[h1]Axyz heads to Prague[/h1]

A reminder we're flying off for Prague tomorrow to be a part of [url=https://www.gdsession.com]Game Developers Session[/url]. If you are attending please stop by to play Axyz. We have a new build with some updated controls and the game feels s m o o t h. 

That's all for now. Thank you as always for your supoport and we'll chat to you again next week!

notes.title: Game Developers Session (GDS) 2024
notes.content:
[h1]Space Lion Studios heads to mainland Europe for the first time![/h1]

Hey everyone!

Apologies for the radio silence on here since the Summer. We've been working non-stop on Axyz over the last couple of months and it's kinda crazy how much the game has evolved since we last spoke. This has taken up the bulk of our time and it means stuff like communication has fallen by the wayside. 

[i]However[/i] going forward we'll plan to get an update across every week or so. We've got a fair few things to talk about, but we'll separate these over the following weeks so you have plenty of time to process each announcement! 

For this week, as you can probably tell by the title - we're heading to Prague! Next week is the [url=https://www.gdsession.com]Game Developers Session Prague[/url] and Axyz will be available to play on the showcase floor across the 13th and 14th December. It's our first time showcasing Axyz in mainland Europe and we cannot wait to present the game to a whole new audience. 

If you're attending please feel free to stop by and say hello! 

[h1]BlueSky[/h1]

One other quick announcement for now - we decided to bin Twitter because [i]let's be honest[/i] it's quite awful over there. While we haven't set up a studio account on BlueSky, Mark (lead design) is on the platform and posting bits and pieces about Axyz (along with anything else on his mind) so feel free to give him a follow [url=https://bsky.app/profile/lithiumproject.bsky.social/post/3lcgmmxtgtc2q]and see sneaky new clips of the game here![/url]

And finally, a massive thank you for wishlisting Axyz and supporting us!
 
Till next time xoxo

notes.title: Dublin Comic Con 2024 - Summer Edition
notes.content:
Hey everyone! It's out first time using Steam to make an announcement so let's hope it all works out!

If you're in Ireland and attending Dublin Comic Con this August, good news! We'll be there again to showcase the latest version of Axyz!

We've made a bunch of updates since we showcased at the Spring event, and we're incredibly excited to present again on August 24th and 25th at The Convention Center in Dublin. Grab your tickets [url=https://dublincomiccon.com]here[/url]!

We hope to see you there!
